Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) additional regions available

Body.Content:
Distribute your PostgreSQL database to horizontally scale queries across multiple machines using sharding. The query engine parallelizes incoming SQL queries across these servers for faster responses on large datasets. The query engine also serves applications that require greater scale and performance for typical workloads approaching or already exceeding 100 GB of data. 

Learn about the supported regions where Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) is available.
